name: map-edits
description: Use this skill when a task changes an Autark map's features as a what-if in a Map Editor node, such as removing buildings, capping heights, reshaping or moving features, or drawing new ones and adding layers. It gives the node's one curio_edit_features call, each edit with its fields, the areas a map can draw, the words that make Solve write edits, and the rule that an analysis filter stays in the node that computes it.
